Blocks.address-block-external-info: Postal address blocks are automatically removed when the patron user updates the postal address in their edu-ID account.
Blocks.address-block-internal-info: Postal address blocks added to institutional accounts are managed by SLSP.
Blocks.email-block-external-info: E-mail blocks are automatically removed when the patron user updates the e-mail address in their edu-ID account.
Blocks.email-block-internal-info: E-Mail blocks added to institutional accounts are managed by SLSP.
Blocks.DoubleRegistrationsDescription: This block is used when a patron has two or more accounts. As soon as the patron merges their duplicate SWITCH edu-ID account, the redundant SLSP account is automatically deleted too (or merged with the remaining account in case of open transactions/fees). Then, the global block from the remaining one can be manually removed via the present platform.
Blocks.WrongAddressDescription: This block is used when a patron user account has a wrong postal address. Since the addresses can only be changed in the Switch edu-ID account, the block is automatically removed as soon as the system receives an update of the address from Switch edu-ID.
Blocks.WrongEmailDescription: This block is used when a patron user account has a wrong e-mail address. Since the addresses can only be changed in the Switch edu-ID account, the block is automatically removed as soon as the system receives an update of the e-mail address from Switch edu-ID.
Blocks.NewAccountDescription: This block is automatically applied when an institution self-registers via the SLSP registration platform. The global block can then be removed via the present platform by the library that approves the eligibility of the institution to get an account according to the criteria list.
Blocks.GlobalBlockDescription: This block can be applied when an account needs to be blocked in all IZs/libraries. Please add the reason for the block in the note field - however, don't add any personal information about the user.
